blocks.text: CAYAN DE ORO CITY — The Philippine Army’s 10th Infantry Division (10ID) said on Thursday it is ready to help police arrest Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, whose one-week ultimatum to surrender ends on Friday. The former national police chief is wanted by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for alleged crimes against humanity during the bloody war on drugs during the Duterte administration. Maj. Ruben Gadut, 10ID spokesperson, said their division is prepared to provide critical intelligence and logistical support to the Philippine National Police (PNP) in the high-stakes pursuit of dela Rosa, READ: PNP tells dela Rosa to surrender anew: […]...
